summary: End-to-end test of the CaaS licensor UI at /os/apps/connected and the client-side /api/caas/client/* API. Backend pytest suite (8/8) passed. Full operator UI journey verified: admit → grant → issue key (secret shown once) → client-side deliver with X-CaaS-Key → revoke key → reissue → revoke licence → suspend/reinstate/revoke client. Analyst read-only role verified. Regression smoke of ARMI, apps/new, apps/requests passed. One UI issue found: horizontal overflow at 390px with a client profile open (scrollWidth 404 > 390). One spec/implementation discrepancy noted (product testid naming).

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow with a client profile open: document.documentElement.scrollWidth = 404 (> 390). Internal tables are correctly wrapped in .estate-table-wrap (licences, keys, deliveries, metering) so the overflow originates elsewhere on the page (likely a non-wrapped section such as the lifecycle rows, licence summary cell contents like terms-identifier, or the overview tile grid min-width).

issues: ~14px horizontal overflow with client profile open; needs min-width audit on CaaS sections / tile grid

spec_divergence.issue: Spec said chips use testid 'caas-grant-product-brand-mention-inventory' / 'caas-grant-product-estate-language-inventory' (all dashes). Implementation uses 'caas-grant-product-brand-mention_inventory' and 'caas-grant-product-estate-language_inventory' (dot→dash but underscore inside sub-name kept). Catalogue cards also use the same underscore (caas-product-estate-language_inventory). Not a functional bug; worth syncing docs/tests.

action_items: Fix mobile horizontal overflow on /os/apps/connected at 390px with a client profile open (scrollWidth=404 vs 390). Audit CaaS section min-widths / overview tile grid.
Reconcile product-chip testid naming: either make them pure-dash to match the review-request spec, or update the external spec/docs to the current underscore form.

(Optional, test ergonomics) Make the ReasonForm (revoke-key/revoke-licence) reason input use type="text" explicitly so broad input[type=text] selectors in older playbooks also pick it up; tests here used the explicit data-testid and worked.
critical_code_review_comments: The CaaS flow is well instrumented with data-testids; ReasonForm uses `disabled={!reason.trim()}` which correctly guards state-changing submits.

Deliver endpoint returns well-shaped payload (delivery_id, accepted, meter{quantity,rate_usd}, raw_estate_exported=false, result.by_language keys kik/kam/swa) and metering reconciles immediately in UI.
After licence/client revocation, previously issued secrets are correctly rejected (401 Key is not active); keys show 'licence revoked: client revoked' label.
Lifecycle list correctly accumulates admitted→suspend→reinstate→revoke entries; action buttons are correctly hidden for a revoked client.
Mobile overflow issue is the only non-trivial regression visible to end users.
seed_data_creation: Created one SYNTHETIC CaaS client 'Testing Agent Media Ltd — SYNTHETIC' (cl-917b677a8b) with one revoked licence lic-c297d2c1bf (2 revoked keys key-e0c7700d92, key-c4f2c50a24) and 1 recorded aggregate delivery dlv-6c81299c36 of brand.mention_inventory. Final status: client revoked; no cleanup needed (no delete API; terminal state).
context_for_next_testing_agent: CaaS backend pytest (8) + client-side X-CaaS-Key regression (/app/test_reports/caas_client_check_iter84.py) are stable and should be run first for CaaS regressions. All operator UI testids match code except product-chip naming uses underscore inside sub-name (e.g. caas-grant-product-brand-mention_inventory). The one open issue is mobile overflow at 390px on /os/apps/connected with a client profile open (sw=404 cw=390).
rca of the issue: Mobile overflow RCA (not completed): all four tables are wrapped in .estate-table-wrap scroll containers, so the 14px overshoot comes from a non-table block. Most likely culprits in /os/apps/connected: (a) the overview tile grid (estate-tiles) possibly having a minmax(220px, …) that forces >390px when a long tile label like 'Raw estate never exported' is present, (b) a long inline token like 'terms-cf40995e408e09f9' inside the licence row profile breaking word-wrap, or (c) client-profile header grid. Suggested check: inspect .estate-section > :not(.estate-table-wrap) child widths at 390px.
